SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, c_salutation, c_preferred_cust_flag, ss_ticket_number, cnt
FROM (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
          AND d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002)
    )
      AND ss_store_sk IN (
        SELECT s_store_sk
        FROM store
        WHERE s_county IN ('Williamson County','Williamson County','Williamson County','Williamson County')
    )
      AND ss_hdemo_sk IN (
        SELECT hd_demo_sk
        FROM household_demographics
        WHERE (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
          AND hd_vehicle_count > 0
          AND CASE WHEN hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN hd_dep_count / hd_vehicle_count ELSE NULL END > 1
    )
    GROUP BY ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
) AS dj
INNER JOIN customer ON dj.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, customer.c_last_name ASC
